sources.snippet: Overview FashionCLIP is a CLIP-like model fine-tuned for the fashion industry. We fine tune CLIP (Radford et al., 2021 on over 700K <image, text> pairs from the Farfetch dataset 1. We evaluate FashionCLIP by applying it to open problems in industry such as retrieval, classification and fashion parsing.

sources.snippet: Download fashion-clip for free. CLIP model fine-tuned for zero-shot fashion product classification. FashionCLIP is a domain-adapted CLIP model fine-tuned specifically for the fashion industry, enabling zero-shot classification and retrieval of fashion products. Developed by Patrick John Chia and collaborators, it builds on the CLIP ViT-B/32 architecture and was trained on over 800K image-text ...
